title: Capture real transcript timing and per-tool duration metadata
description: Vetted from Audit #7 findings 10.4 and 10.6. Transcript export currently records zero timing and misses tool duration details. Capture first-token and total duration using stopwatch instrumentation and persist per-tool timing metadata in transcript records.
